def gap_runs(inp,bg,shape):
    H=len(inp);W=len(inp[0]);out=set()
    for i in range(H):
        row=inp[i]
        j=0
        while j<W:
            if row[j]!=bg: j+=1;continue
            s=j
            while j<W and row[j]==bg: j+=1
            e=j-1
            hasL = s>0 and row[s-1]==shape
            hasR = e<W-1 and row[e+1]==shape
            if hasL and hasR:
                out.update((i,k) for k in range(s,e+1))
    for j in range(W):
        col=[inp[i][j] for i in range(H)]
        i=0
        while i<H:
            if col[i]!=bg: i+=1;continue
            s=i
            while i<H and col[i]==bg: i+=1
            e=i-1
            hasU = s>0 and col[s-1]==shape
            hasD = e<H-1 and col[e+1]==shape
            if hasU and hasD:
                out.update((k,j) for k in range(s,e+1))
    return out

from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get); sc=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg][0]
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(H):
        j=0
        while j<W:
            if g[i][j]==sc:
                a=j
                while j+1<W and g[i][j+1]==sc: j+=1; b=j
                for c in range(a-1,-1,-1):
                    if g[i][c]==bg: o[i][c]=2
                    elif g[i][c]!=bg: break
                for c in range(b+1,W):
                    if g[i][c]==bg: o[i][c]=2
                    else: break
                j=b+1
            else: j+=1
    for j in range(W):
        i=0
        while i<H:
            if g[i][j]==sc:
                a=i
                while i+1<H and g[i+1][j]==sc: i+=1; b=i
                for r in range(a-1,-1,-1):
                    if g[r][j]==bg: o[r][j]=2
                    else: break
                for r in range(b+1,H):
                    if g[r][j]==bg: o[r][j]=2
                    else: break
                i=b+1
            else: i+=1
    return o

allmatch=True
for n in [6,7,8]:
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    r=f(gi); m=r==go; allmatch&=m
    print(n,m)
print('ALL',allmatch)
